Normalizations, f≥0, λ>0, essential support, δ/η and dimension quantifiers checked. Finite diagnostics illustrate only.

originality.rationale: The theorem classifies exact positive-real-ray local resolvent type for every positive vector of V tensor-power in terms of joint essential support. Ji–Zhang Theorem C treats the full-plane power-set range of one-variable V and support-interval witnesses; Hu–Ji–Liang Theorems 1.4 and 1.6 treat abstract existence and realization. Neither implies the multidimensional vectorwise support formula. Extensive actual published-finding corpus searches and comparison with accessible historical claims produced no covering statement. Classical positive-kernel/Laplace principle priority remains a candid residual risk.
residual_risks: Other general positive-kernel Laplace-principle theorems or older multivariate Volterra papers could imply the claimed specialized formula; no assertion of global search completeness.
Published published-finding corpus near hits were checked at metadata/claim level only, not falsely presented as full-text inspections.

value.rationale: This determines an entire natural local-resolvent growth filtration of the positive cone of the tensor Volterra operator, not merely a set of attainable numbers. The cross/diagonal example proves that its invariant depends on intercoordinate correlation and is not recoverable from any separate one-variable support data. This is a motivated structural extension of the one-variable power-set question to a genuinely multivariate, nonseparable-input setting; no downstream theorem is needed for this complete classification.
